hypotheses_validated.claim: Finding 1 (major) reproduced and closed by tests; synth.py needed no code change. The softmax, sigmoid and group branches of make_tiny's routing-margin check now each have a self-validating test. For each redraw seed the test first shows that the near-tie exists with only that branch disabled, then shows that the shipped make_tiny clears every margin. Margins are re-measured independently from router_trace, against literal thresholds, never read back from synth.
hypotheses_validated.evidence: Reproduced the verifier's numbers. deepseek_v3 seed 4 with the sigmoid check off: selection gap 2.34e-05 (shipped 4.75e-03). Golden big_q4 (deepseek_v3 Q4, 4x32, top-4, seed 3) with the group check off: group gap 2.28e-04 (shipped 6.62e-04). A seed survey found mixtral seed 1, the golden F32 fixture seed, needs a softmax redraw. New tests: test_margin_problem_branches (crafted arrays for every rank boundary, each branch, the group boundary, top_k == n_experts, and exact-threshold equality), test_make_tiny_redraws_near_ties (12 seeds: softmax mixtral1/qwen3_moe0/olmoe8; sigmoid deepseek 4/5/9/14 and big 2/4; group deepseek 7/16 and big 3), and test_golden_f32_fixtures_have_clear_margins. The verifier's mutation command (synth.py 171-186, seed 1) went from 73.3% to 100% (44/44 candidates). Setting _SIGMOID_ABS_GAP, _GROUP_ABS_GAP or _SOFTMAX_REL_GAP to -1 in-process now fails 12, 9 and 9 tests (the verifier saw 0). Every golden fixture clears the contract; the tightest is big_q4 at 1.31x (selection) and 1.10x (group).

hypotheses_validated.claim: Finding 2 fixed. Reference handles rope_dim = 0 (no rotation, no rope_inv_freq needed). MLA rotates only the first rope_dim (<= qk_rope_dim) dims of q_pe and k_pe, with pairs formed relative to rope_dim.
hypotheses_validated.evidence: test_rope_dim_zero_means_no_rotation (qwen3_moe and deepseek_v3): with rope_inv_freq absent, or present with junk shape [3], the logits are bit-identical to rotation by zero frequencies at factor 1. test_mla_partial_rotary (rope_dim 2 and 8 with GPT-J pairs): bit-identical to rope_dim 16 with zero frequencies past rope_dim. Before the fix both cases raised KeyError or broadcast silently, as the verifier reported.

hypotheses_validated.claim: Finding 3 fixed. The writer turns every bytes-like input into a flat C-contiguous byte view and checks its byte count, in write_tensor, write_tensor_rows and write_expert.
hypotheses_validated.evidence: Reproduced: a float32 memoryview of 64 items was accepted for a 64-byte U8 tensor and overwrote the next tensor (b read back [0 0 224 64 ...]). test_writer_byte_buffers_are_sized_in_bytes now pins: the 256-byte view is rejected and b stays intact; a 64-byte float32 view, 2-D uint8 and float32 views, f16 row chunks and memoryview expert payloads are accepted and round-trip; non-contiguous buffers are rejected; a 32-byte chunk is refused as 'bad chunk'.

hypotheses_validated.claim: Finding 4 fixed. The writer always validates metadata through apply_defaults, including when a required key is missing. None values are dropped first, exactly as encode_meta drops them.
hypotheses_validated.evidence: test_missing_required_meta_and_bad_layer_kind: each of the 4 required keys missing, and a layer_kind of the wrong length, is refused at the first write and at close() without writes, and no file is left. Forged files (validation monkeypatched) are refused by the reader. The new bos_id test exposed a pre-existing inconsistency (bos_id=None crashed validation) and now pins None and -1 as 'no BOS' and 0 as BOS 0.

hypotheses_validated.claim: Finding 6 fixed. Reference validates, before computing anything, every tensor the forward pass reads against FORMAT.md 4.1: presence, exact shape, and F32 for norms, biases, rope_inv_freq, moe_router and moe_router_bias. The table is format.canonical_tensors(config), shared with the converter, which used to have its own _expected_shape. A rejected container's reader is closed explicitly.
hypotheses_validated.evidence: test_reference_validates_tensors_against_format: 12 forged cases are all ValueError, including the verifier's [1]-shaped attn_norm, moe_router_bias, out_norm and attn_kv_a_norm, a same-nbytes reshaped tok_embd, F16/BF16 norm and router, missing q_b, rope_inv_freq, k_bias and shexp_gate_inp, and a short q_bias. Tied embeddings, shared_gate=0 and extra unknown tensors are still accepted. A ContainerReader subclass spy proves the explicit close; an unlink check could not, because CPython's refcounting closes the reader as soon as pytest drops the exception. test_canonical_tensor_table_matches_make_tiny checks the table equals make_tiny's tensors for all 5 archs. test_name_mapping_covers_checkpoint checks the converter plan plus rope_inv_freq equals the table for all 6 HF cases.

hypotheses_validated.claim: Finding 7 fixed. ContainerReader rejects what engine/src/modelfile.c check_regions rejects: any overlap among preamble, metadata, directories, tensors and physical slabs; entries sharing a slab that differ in nbytes or dtype; and more than one unflagged entry on one slab. As in C, a slab whose entries are all flagged is accepted.
hypotheses_validated.evidence: Structural differential against a scratch harness around hx_modelfile_open, built with hxcc from modelfile.c as of 13:38 (scratchpad t03g3/mfcheck.c and diff_regions.py; not in the repo). 1500 random tensor/slab offset, size, flag, dtype and dim-swap mutations of tiny and aliased make_shaped containers: 1500/1500 agree (507 accepted by both, 993 rejected by both). Negative control with _check_regions disabled: 619/1500 (881 rejected only by C). Reference on the 507 accepted files: 457 evaluate, 50 ValueError (FORMAT shape violations), 0 other exceptions. The previous metadata differential, rerun on the new harness: 1262/1262 agree, 394 accepted by both. Reference on those 394: 316 evaluate, 78 ValueError, 0 KeyError (gen-002: 333 / 42 / 19 KeyError). The 17 files that used to evaluate were silent broadcasts of metadata-inconsistent shapes. Unit cases in test_malformed_files_raise cover tensor on tensor, preamble, metadata, tdir and edir; slab on header and slab on slab; shared slab unflagged, dtype, and size; and alias, all-flagged and lone-flag acceptance.

hypotheses_validated.claim: Finding 8 fixed. The converter's chunk threshold and step are module constants (_CHUNK_ELEMS, _CHUNK_TARGET). A test drives the chunked path for every dense matrix of an FP8 DeepSeek-V3 checkpoint with 32x32 scale blocks.
hypotheses_validated.evidence: test_chunked_tensor_path_matches_whole (torch and numpy backends x F32 and Q8 dense) produces output byte-identical to whole-tensor conversion. Chunk starts are asserted: tok_embd and lm_head every 32 rows; FP8 attn_q_b [128, 64] at 0/32/64/96, i.e. four different scale-block rows. A second configuration checks the strict '>' boundary and a 2-block step. test_expert_width_differs_from_d_model covers F=96 != D=64, which no earlier tiny model had: expert orientation, HF logits within 2e-3 relative, and Q4-to-F16 slab fallback.
